test_knee_dataset_lengths: test the knee MRI dataset lengths by validating SliceDataset against expected split sizes
test_brain_dataset_lengths: test the brain MRI dataset lengths by validating SliceDataset against expected split sizes
test_combined_dataset_lengths: test the combined knee and brain MRI dataset lengths using CombinedSliceDataset
run_SliceDataset: run a SliceDataset on knee or brain MRI data with a specified challenge mode
run_CombinedSliceDataset: run a CombinedSliceDataset that merges multiple MRI dataset splits with their own transforms and challenges
